cards.title: The live chart dock payload
cards.does: A docked chart card DRAWS its data inside the card (lines drawn over the hold, bars grown, share rows filled, checklist rows typed) from the same data as its PNG, the PNG kept as the static fallback.

author.key: a `<asset>.series.json` beside the dock's asset file (no row key)

cards.title: The record document dock payload
cards.does: A paper document mounts in the card and TYPES its quotation word by word on the narrator's own word times, a highlighter sweeping through the pulled phrase as each word is said, then the attribution and the source line appear.
cards.when: the sentence QUOTES someone's claim and the words themselves are the proof - the record types the line and the highlighter lands on the phrase as it is said

author.key: the dock META entry's `record` {hdr, kicker, words, hl, end, attr, src} in <build>/evidence-dock.json (kit: authoring/docks.py record_words + record_asset + meta_set)

phases.name: type
phases.does: the words appear on their own timestamps; the current word is sliced letter by letter, a cursor at the end

dials.word_type_s: max(0.08, (next word time - this word time) x 0.72)

phases.name: highlight
phases.does: words hl[0]..hl[1] carry the highlighter stroke, swept in from each word's own time

phases.name: attribute
phases.does: the attribution line shows, then the source line

lives.note: P57 T21: extracted from the engine's drawRecord with every golden byte-identical; the dock slot keeps the fillDock mount and calls paintRecord by name (no DOCK_PAINTERS registry)

callable.why: author the META `record` (the kit builds it from the take); no validator, no golden

cards.title: The verdict stack

aliases.name: pull back in all of our evidence cards

cards.does: Already-shown proofs fly in from depth one at a time on their own phrases, each held large at centre while spoken, then receding to one of nine rail spots as a mosaic; railed cards float, and on the pivot line all burst radially.
cards.when: the sentence lists N proofs of one claim in a row ('three things say so') - each flies in on its word; a list, not one chart

author.key: dock META entry `species: "stack"` with `stack: {items: [{id, at}], clear_at}` in <build>/evidence-dock.json, docked by a shot-table tuple whose window runs past clear_at

phases.name: enter
phases.does: the card flies in from depth, swinging in from the side, rotating flat and fading up, to its FOCUS pose
phases.trigger: items[i].at - the item's verbatim beat (one card at a time)

dials.dir: +1 for odd i, -1 for even i

phases.name: focus
phases.does: the card holds LARGE near stage centre while its phrase is spoken, drifting (sine wander + scale breathing)
phases.trigger: between its own at and the next item's at

dials.tilt_deg: tilt x (1 - a) + sin(...) x 0.6 x a

phases.name: recede
phases.does: the card eases back to its RAIL SPOT - nine asymmetric spots around the page, the centre kept open - so the page fills as a mosaic around the talking card

dials.layout: four across the top, the mid-frame flanks, three along the bottom

phases.name: idle
phases.does: railed cards float almost still at their tilt

phases.name: burst
phases.does: every card is thrown RADIALLY along its own bearing from stage centre, spinning, scaling up and fading, staggered

dials.throw_px: 560 x bx, 420 x by (bx, by = the card centre's offset from stage centre over 700/1920 and 460/1080 of the stage)
dials.teardown: the .stackbox is removed at t > clear_at + 1.4 s or t < dock enter - 0.5 s
